videos.title: The nervous system: an overview
videos.focus: Watch for: Identify sensory input, integration and motor output. Do not try to memorize every term before it has been taught.

videos.title: The structure of a neuron: recap
videos.focus: Watch for: Pause at each labelled structure and explain its function without looking back at the table.

videos.title: Reflex arcs: example 1
videos.focus: Watch for: Trace the sensory route into the CNS and the motor route to the effector. Distinguish the response from conscious awareness.

videos.title: Reflex arcs: example 2
videos.focus: Watch for: Compare the example with the five components in the withdrawal pathway. Notice whether an interneuron is shown.

videos.title: Electrical conduction: overview
videos.focus: Watch for: Identify the resting state before the voltage changes. Keep ion movement separate from the voltage it produces.

videos.title: Action potential recap 1
videos.focus: Watch for: Track which ion moves, which direction it moves, and what happens to the inside voltage.

videos.title: Action potential recap 2
videos.focus: Watch for: Explain the resting state, depolarization, repolarization and recovery in order.

videos.title: Action potential recap 3
videos.focus: Watch for: Match the membrane events with the rising, falling and undershoot regions of a voltage graph.

videos.title: Synaptic transmission: first recap
videos.focus: Watch for: Explain the sequence from arrival of the action potential to binding on the postsynaptic membrane.

videos.title: Synaptic transmission: second recap
videos.focus: Watch for: Identify what ends the signal. Compare reuptake with breakdown by an enzyme.

videos.title: Excitatory and inhibitory neurotransmitters
videos.focus: Watch for: Compare the effect on the postsynaptic membrane rather than memorizing only the transmitter’s name.

videos.title: Peripheral nervous system: explanation 1
videos.focus: Watch for: Identify what connects to the CNS and distinguish the sensory route from the motor route.

videos.title: Peripheral nervous system: explanation 2
videos.focus: Watch for: Compare somatic control of skeletal muscle with autonomic control of internal effectors.

videos.title: Autonomic responses: recap
videos.focus: Watch for: Follow the contrasting effects on pupils, heart activity and digestion.

videos.title: Introduction to the brain
videos.focus: Watch for: Locate the major regions before trying to recall their functions. Keep the brainstem and cerebellum distinct.

videos.title: Structures of the brain: first recap
videos.focus: Watch for: Point to a structure, say its name, and state one function before continuing.

videos.title: Structures of the brain: second recap
videos.focus: Watch for: Distinguish the cerebrum, cerebellum, brainstem, thalamus and hypothalamus.

videos.title: Nervous system: final quick review
videos.focus: Watch for: Trace the connections among neurons, impulses, synapses, CNS, PNS and homeostasis. Use this as a final review, not a replacement for the chapter reading.

videos.title: Stress response and anxiety: first extra
videos.focus: Watch for: Connect the discussion with the autonomic response already taught. Separate a general explanation from advice for an individual.

videos.title: Stress response and anxiety: second extra
videos.focus: Watch for: Identify how the discussion relates to sympathetic and parasympathetic activity.

videos.title: Childhood experience and the brain: extension
videos.focus: Watch for: Identify the claims being made and the evidence offered. Do not infer an individual diagnosis from a general example.

videos.title: Addiction: disease, learning and the brain
videos.focus: Watch for: Distinguish the presenter’s framework from the specific synaptic mechanisms taught in the chapter.
